verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a payments/commerce platform that exposes its own APIs as tools (via an agent toolkit and its own MCP server) for other agents to consume — it is not itself an AI agent/runtime that a user configures by plugging in external MCP servers. The evidence consistently shows PayPal as the MCP *server*/tool provider (paypal-agent-commerce-docs-9, paypal-ac-supp-agent-toolkit), the opposite direction of this story, so the axis does not apply to this product type.
